title: SpawnEggs+
description: This resource pack makes spawn eggs look better in Minecraft.
body:
# 🥚 SpawnEggs+

✨ Give every Spawn Egg a fresh, cleaner and more recognizable look!

**━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━**
![SpawnEggs+ Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b6836c7cd97425b273555e228e4ec855afa93ac.png)
**━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━**

📦 Features
- ✔ Redesigned Spawn Egg icons

- ✔ Easy to recognize at a glance

- ✔ Vanilla-friendly style

- ✔ Supports **Minecraft +1.21.8**

- ✔ Lightweight and performance-friendly

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎨 Why use this pack?

Instead of random-looking color combinations, each Spawn Egg has been redesigned to better represent the mob it spawns while keeping the classic Minecraft aesthetic.

Perfect for survival, creative mode, and map making.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✅ Compatibility

- 🎮 Minecraft **+1.21.8**

- 📁 Resource Pack only

- ⚡ No OptiFine required

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💚 If you enjoy this pack, don't forget to ⭐ Favorite it and leave a comment!
